name: Stained Glass — Originating Light, Spectrum, Panes, Seams, and Returning Recognition
description: The authored optical movement: light entering a made aperture, the implicated spectrum, panes and seams as refractive apparatus, the changing projection disclosing the construction, and recognition returning to the aperture.

scenes.name: Light entering a made aperture
scenes.character: Sun, aperture, glass, seams, room and viewer belong to one event; what is prior in being is later in recognition.

entities.name: the originating light — priority over the projected image
the window — panes and lead as a made aperture

Bimba / pratibimba — the Original prior in being, later in recognition

text.title: Light entering a made aperture
text.italic: The whole embodies constructing from diaphaneity: composing a work so its originating relation becomes perceptible through the differences of its materials.

text.body: Light enters a room through a window assembled from differently coloured panes. The panes give it determinate passages; the lead holds their boundaries; an image falls into the interior where someone can encounter it. The visible colour carries the work of relations the colour alone cannot display completely. This is Frank Taylor's authored Mytheme of constructing from diaphaneity — no

historical window or sacred programme reconstructed. The originating light has priority over the projected image, yet the viewer encounters the image first and follows its differences back: what is prior in being can be later in recognition. Bimba names the Original order; pratibimba names its determinate display; neither viewer nor maker supplies the Original by finishing the picture.
Occurrences: the light, aperture and cast image (#0, transformed at #4); the encounter-first asymmetry (#0, #5→0).

text.kicker: #1 · the corrected Q27 assignment; the native theorem spine
text.title: The spectrum implicated in the light
text.italic: The assignment demonstrates the immanence: QL belongs to the originating light as its harmonic articulation — spectral language attributes no optics to a Śaiva author, and no pane receives a permanent number.

text.body: The white light carries plenitude: its apparent unity holds the possibility of differentiated colour together with the relations through which the colours belong to one field. Within Taylor's optic this full ordered spectrum figures QL — immanent to the originating light as its harmonic articulation. The pane gives a difference a passage; it does not first create the capacity for difference in a contentless source.

The native theorem spine grounds the relation: the parent phases bearing the positional field in inverse orientations, the First Spanda's source-to-expression and return-to-recognition joined through their interference term. The optical whole makes that fullness and return visible, leaving the equations' derivation in the theorem field. QL's sixfold body and eight-determination traversal remain distinct from the number of panes: none requires a pane to receive a permanent number, tradition or colour.
Occurrences: the plenitude and its spectrum (#1, differentiated at #2); the First Spanda's interference term (#1); the pane-count independence (#1, #2).

text.kicker: #2 · Q27:2937–2950 governing the assignments (human-amplified: yes); C39
text.title: Colour acquires a passage; the joins stay visible
text.italic: The seams embody method: choosing and joining materials already determines how the source can become visible — a source enters because its operation changes what the whole can disclose.

text.body: Each pane has a material, density, colour and angle: placement permits some transmission, bends or colours what passes, leaves something obstructed. Removing every difference in pursuit of neutrality would also remove the transformations through which the composition becomes articulate. The original quilt distinguishes the window from an opaque mosaic: the mosaic arranges fragments into a surface image; the window works through transmission and obstruction as well as arrangement.

The lead cames carry the joins — holding neighbouring panes in relation while marking where one passage ends and another begins; in the epistemic construction the seams retain provenance, discontinuity, translation limits, contradiction and changes of register. These figure MEF, whose office C39 defines: a lens changes a question, a permissible inference or an act of judgment while keeping its conditions inspectable.
Occurrences: the pane placements (#2); the lead's held joins (#2, reused at #4's comparison); the corrected apparatus/light assignment (#2, carried through #5→0).

text.kicker: #3–#4 · P5's invested reading; Gebser pp.1–3, 11–21, 255–58; A04; A16/A22; Symbolon Dynamics
text.title: The image appears; changing light discloses the construction
text.italic: Recognition proceeds through exact differences among the projections towards the order they disclose — neither averaging differences nor adding them into a final picture.

text.body: The coloured display is produced through the relation of light and made aperture, encountered from a position. Looking only at the glass misses the event of transmission; looking only at the image conceals the glass, its joins and placement. The situated image is pratibimba; its danger begins when availability becomes a claim to possess the source. The viewer is implicated: body, position, attention and concern enter what is seen.

changes: a later display makes visible a region previously obscured. The order recognisable across the transformations belongs to Bimba/QL; the appearances remain pratibimbas. The 180°→360° movement names the contextual turn — positions ceasing to claim isolated completeness as joint conditions become available. The atlas carries the complementary discipline: a chart-transition is not light passing through glass; each whole retains the operation the other cannot perform.
Occurrences: the changing sun and revealed region (#4); the implicated viewer (#3, #4); the atlas/window distinction (#4, #5→0).

scenes.character: A seam examined, a source reread, a translation qualified, a lens repositioned, an exclusion allowed to affect the next judgment. The luminous image and its historical limits.

text.kicker: #5→0 · the source boundaries; the declared returns to C09, C37, C39, M05, M30, M36
text.title: Recognition returns to the aperture
text.italic: The whole returns-to its movements without substituting the image for derivations, warrants or tests: an essay section can carry the whole relational movement from its own angle — QL's native recursion supplying the capacity.

text.body: The viewer returns to the window with a changed understanding: what first appeared as a self-contained pattern now discloses the source, selected passages and boundaries of its appearing. A seam can be examined, a source reread, a translation qualified, a lens repositioned, an exclusion allowed to affect the next judgment.

The Original remains prior: within a declared Context Frame the achieved map can serve as local Bimba while remaining pratibimba to wider sources; returned evidence can correct that local Bimba itself. Dyczkowski's lattice-window image gives an account of light appearing diverse through limiting conditions; the mirror analogy loses the external object; an inert mirror can display without knowing — Vimarśa names the self-apprehending power. Bohm is Resonant with, not extraction.
Occurrences: the examined seam and reread source (#2, #5→0); the local-Bimba office (#4, #5→0); the declared movement returns (#5→0).
